parsed.rationale: Both `RemoteCommandProtocol` (line 17) and `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` (line 24) are declared in the same file `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RemoteCommandCenterProtocol.swift` within the `Playback` package, and `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` is a strict superset of `RemoteCommandProtocol`: it shares all three members (`addTarget:`, `isEnabled:`, `removeTarget:`) and adds only `preferredIntervals:[NSNumber]`. Making `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` inherit from `RemoteCommandProtocol` eliminates the three duplicated member declarations, expresses the natural 'skip command is a remote command' relationship, and allows any code typed as `RemoteCommandProtocol` to accept skip-interval commands polymorphically. Neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), so no restraint rule applies.
